method: Wave 2 of the v1.3 external set, same inclusion rules as wave 1 (results/v1.3-external/selection.json on branch v1.3-external-set, PR #133). Candidate pool: the GitHub repository search (via the session's GitHub MCP tool: TypeScript, created before mid-2022, sorted by stars, queries 'clean architecture', 'hexagonal', 'ports adapters', topic:hexagonal-architecture, 'ddd', 'nestjs api', 'express typescript boilerplate'), plus web search. Unlike wave 1, the search API WAS used for discovery; inclusion was decided only by the probe below. 123 distinct candidates probed by anonymous blobless git clone (pinned commit, author and committer dates, licence file at the pin, package.json licence, .ts counts, README claim). Inclusion, in order: (1) public, permissive licence (MIT/ISC/BSD/Apache) in a licence file at the pinned commit; (2) TypeScript backend that claims the style in its README or folder structure; (3) pinned to the last commit before 2023-01-01 of the default branch (when that commit is a bot commit, the last human commit is recorded and must predate ChatGPT, 2022-11-30, with no src/ change in between); (4) 15-300 non-test, non-declaration .ts files under src/ of the analysis root; (5) not in the Study 1 corpus (corpus/corpus.json), not among the 14 W1 wild repositories (PR #114) and not in wave 1 (PR #133); (6) preference for well-known references. srcTsFiles excludes *.spec.ts, *.test.ts, __tests__/, test/ and tests/ folders.
